name: series-continuity-director
description: Direct a recurring-character series so the story above it and the identity, state, wardrobe, prop ownership, camera geography and accepted history below it survive from scene to scene and chapter to chapter. The series may be screen, comics or prose: a scene is realized as shots, as pages of panels, or as passages.

interface.shortDescription: Keep a recurring character series continuous across shots and episodes.
interface.longDescription: Direct a recurring-character series so the story above it and the identity, state, wardrobe, prop ownership, camera geography and accepted history below it survive from scene to scene and chapter to chapter. The series may be screen, comics or prose: a scene is realized as shots, as pages of panels, or as passages.
defaultPrompt: Plan the next scene of this series and write the start frame for its first shot.
